title: 2026 UK CBAM commodity-scope QA controls

sources.title: Check which goods are in scope of Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM)
Carbon border adjustment mechanism (CBAM): Policy Summary

facts.source_fact: UK CBAM scope guidance covers aluminium, cement, fertiliser, hydrogen, and iron and steel sectors.
The scope guidance concerns CBAM goods imported into the UK.
facts.expected_handling: Do not apply the commodity gate to non-import events.

facts.source_fact: Importers determine whether goods are in scope by checking commodity codes.
facts.expected_handling: Require commodity-code classification before liability logic.

facts.source_fact: HMRC publishes separate HTML scope tables for each of the five sectors.
The CBAM policy summary annex maps commodity codes to relevant greenhouse gases.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve both commodity code and gas mapping.

facts.source_fact: The iron and steel guidance explains HS chapter, heading, sub-heading and longer commodity-code structure.
facts.expected_handling: Do not truncate a code where a more specific code is required.

facts.source_fact: The policy-summary annex identifies carbon dioxide and perfluorocarbons for multiple aluminium commodity codes.
facts.expected_handling: Do not assume every in-scope good has only CO2.

facts.source_fact: CBAM returns require the relevant 8-digit commodity code in force when the good passed the tax point.
facts.expected_handling: Version commodity codes by tax-point date.

facts.source_fact: Different CBAM goods in the same shipment are reported separately on the return.
facts.expected_handling: Do not collapse unlike commodity lines into one emissions record.

facts.source_fact: After determining whether goods are in scope, HMRC directs users to determine whether they are classed as the importer.
facts.expected_handling: Run scope classification before liable-person classification.

guard_patterns.handling: Bind codes to the applicable tax-point version.
Apply only to imported CBAM goods.
Keep different goods and consignments separately traceable.
Complete scope check before importer and threshold checks.
Use the 16 July 2026 HMRC publication state.
Do not infer parcel or facility emissions from commodity scope.
Flag unresolved code, sector or gas conflicts.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; 10 x 10 = 100 controls
